doc: I43 prereg sidecar (BUILD_PLAN I43 'Theory core II; Lean for the promoted set' and whitepaper sections 6.1-6.2, 6.4, 8.8, Q14c). Computed at prereg by tests_m3/_i43.py::theory_core_ii_doc independently of holon/ from the frozen inputs listed with their sha256. Records: (1) the 10 polymorphic Bend 2 laws in THEORY_CORE_II (5 equivariance laws and 5 2-cell pasting laws); (2) the 4 concrete M3 equivariance basis laws in gen/M3/basis/equivariance/ and 4 concrete M3 pasting basis laws in gen/M3/basis/pasting/ over the M1 morph_rollup model; (3) the 92 PROVED laws across M0..M3 (5 M0 + 8 M1 + 6 M2 + 73 M3) promoted to independence_class I2 via Lean 4.34.0 verification in gen/M3/lean/ and results/M3/lean.json with axioms within {propext, Quot.sound}; (4) the 5 negative canaries across theory_core_ii, equivariance, pasting, and lean, all predicted REFUTED under bend / bend --verdict or holon.lean.check_text. The build never reads this file; the tests recompute and compare against it.

laws.doc: equivariance under step composition: if f(s1(x)) == t1(f(x)) and f(s2(x)) == t2(f(x)), then f(s1(s2(a))) == t1(t2(f(a)))
equivariance under morphism composition (whiskering): if f(s(x)) == t(f(x)) and g(t(y)) == u(g(y)), then g(f(s(a))) == u(g(f(a)))
equivariant observation transport: if f(s(a)) == t(f(a)), obs_B(t(b)) == obs_B(b), and obs_B(f(a)) == obs_A(a), then obs_B(f(s(a))) == obs_A(a)
equivariant Boolean invariant preservation: if f(s(a)) == t(f(a)), Q(t(b)) == Q(b), Q(f(a)) == P(a), and P(a) == True{}, then Q(f(s(a))) == True{}
2-cell homotopy transport of equivariance across a pointwise equal source step: if s1(a) == s2(a) and f(s2(a)) == t(f(a)), then f(s1(a)) == t(f(a))
2x2 grid pasting of four 2-cells: horizontal f1 == f2 == f3 and vertical g1 == g2 == g3 compose to g1(f1(a)) == g3(f3(a))
3-stage horizontal pasting: f1 == f2, g1 == g2, and h1 == h2 along A -> B -> C -> D compose to h1(g1(f1(a))) == h2(g2(f2(a)))
vertical observation pasting across two refinement legs: obs_B(f(a)) == obs_A(a) and obs_C(g(b)) == obs_B(b) compose to obs_C(g(f(a))) == obs_A(a)
adjacent commutative-square pasting: v(f(a)) == f1(u(a)) and w(g(b)) == g1(v(b)) paste to w(g(f(a))) == g1(f1(u(a)))
Eckmann-Hilton interchange path (pre-whisker along f1 then post-whisker along g2): g1(f1(a)) == g2(f1(a)) and f1(a) == f2(a) compose to g1(f1(a)) == g2(f2(a))
